statement: Pinned Linux and SDL consumers send Bluetooth DS4 output 0x11 as 78 bytes. Report byte 1 is hardware control, byte 2 audio control, byte 3 holds motor/LED/blink validity bits 0x01/0x02/0x04, bytes 6-7 carry right/left motor levels, bytes 8-10 RGB, bytes 11-12 blink on/off, and the last four bytes contain little-endian CRC32 seeded with HID output header 0xA2. Device acceptance or actuator behavior is not observed.
